title: Pool sizing guidance lives only in .c — header says pass 0 for default but does not explain consequence of under-sizing
description: The wc_crypto2dev_init() header in crypto2dev_port.h says 'Pass 0 to use the compile-time default WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_POOL_SIZE (8)' but does not mention that under-sizing returns WC_HW_E under concurrent load. The sizing guidance (TLS server needs N slots for N concurrent in-flight AES-GCM records) is in the .c file only. Users integrating from the header will configure pool_size=0 and later get unexplained WC_HW_E at scale. Add the key guidance to the header where it can be found without reading the implementation.
